description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Pressing OK in Image Properties on an existing image now edits it in place, so an unchanged image keeps its relative src (images/logo.png), its width and height, its inline CSS (including quoted font names) and any other attribute. Previously the src could become an absolute file path or use backslashes, and in Internet Explorer 11 mode the image jumped to its natural size. Relative image paths are now written with forward slashes. ALM bug #1524.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
